meta.name: antinet-doc-parse
meta.description: 软件开发工程师与数据科学家在构建RAG系统时，当需处理PDF/Word/Excel等多格式复杂文档，用此技能可自动触发三级解析降级，一键输出高置信度结构化Markdown与元数据，免去繁琐清洗，直接夯实企业知识库数据底座！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 解析多格式文档为结构化Markdown
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在构建知识库时需要解析各种格式的文档
copy.tagline_en: Parse multi-format documents into structured Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to parse various document formats for your knowledge base

howto.what: 把 PDF、Word、Excel 等文档解析成结构化 Markdown，并产出标题、页数、表格数等元数据、0–1 的解析置信度，以及最终生效的解析器名称。
howto.when: 密卷房收到已通过安全扫描的文件时调用；解析器失败会自动降级到下一档，三级全失败则标记「人工介入」并回传 BLOCKED。

say.text: 帮我解析这份 PDF，输出结构化 Markdown 和置信度
say.note: 会按三级 fallback 依次尝试解析器

say.text: 解析这个 Word 文档，告诉我标题、页数和表格数
say.note: 结果含正文 Markdown 与元数据

say.text: 只解析 PDF 和 Excel 这两种格式
say.note: 通过格式白名单限制解析范围

howto.what_en: Parses PDF, Word, Excel and other documents into structured Markdown plus metadata (title, page count, table count), a 0–1 confidence score, and the name of the parser that was actually used.
howto.when_en: Called when the Mijuanfang worker receives a file that has passed the security scan; on parser failure it steps down to the next level, and if all three fail it is marked for human review with BLOCKED returned.

say_en.text: Parse this PDF and give me the structured Markdown plus confidence
say_en.note: Tries the three parsers in fallback order

say_en.text: Parse this Word file and report its title, page count and tables
say_en.note: Output includes body Markdown and metadata

say_en.text: Only parse PDF and Excel files
say_en.note: Limits parsing via the format whitelist
